slides.title: Hands full. Can I just send a voice note?
slides.sub: Hold the mic and say it like you'd tell a friend.

slides.title: Can it remind my mum, not just me?
slides.sub: It lands in her WhatsApp. No app, no account.

slides.title: Which languages does it understand?
slides.sub: Write or speak in any of the four.

slides.title: Think it. *Say it.* Done.
lines: Memopai is a reminder contact in your WhatsApp.
Every day, every Monday, every 1st · until you say stop.
